title: Find initial focus points for a change
request: Identify the smallest set of files a developer should inspect first to understand this repository's main runtime entry point and validation path. Do not edit files.

title: Review impact paths for a proposed change
request: For a change to context metering or evidence export, identify likely impacted source files, docs, and tests. Summarize the impact path and the minimum validation commands. Do not edit files.

title: Find test and validation entry points
request: Find likely test, lint, and validation commands for this repository. Explain which commands are safe local validation commands and which files support that conclusion. Do not edit files.

title: Triage a small issue before editing
request: A user reports that an evidence summary confuses controlled prompt evidence with live command evidence. Locate the likely files, explain the smallest safe fix, and state what tests or checks would validate it. Do not edit files.

title: Explain project purpose and safe first commands
request: Explain this repository's purpose, where a non-expert should start reading, and which local commands are safe to run first. Avoid source-code deep dives unless needed.

title: Explain measurement mode and insufficient pair evidence
request: Explain how to turn ScopeLease measurement mode on or off and how a non-expert should interpret insufficient pair evidence. Keep the answer plain-language and do not edit files.

title: Decide whether an agent action should be approved
request: Given a proposed local patch and a proposed test command, explain in plain language what the approval would allow, what it would not allow, and when the agent should stop and ask again. Do not edit files.

title: Review evidence bundle boundaries
request: Review where ScopeLease stores evidence bundles and explain what can be shared externally versus what should remain local runtime state. Do not edit files.

title: Debug ML submission generation
request: For a Kaggle-style ML task, verify whether the training script would generate a submission with the expected id and target columns. Identify the smallest context needed before editing. Do not edit files.

title: Trace data or experiment provenance
request: Identify which files or artifacts would be needed to explain how an experiment result was produced, what is missing for reproducibility, and what should be included in a report. Do not edit files.

title: Validate reported metrics and caveats
request: Check whether a reported token or cost reduction metric is computed from paired fresh-run evidence, whether negative rows are retained, and whether the caveats match the measurement boundary. Do not edit files.

title: Review shell command and lease scope safety
request: Review whether a safe test command scope could be expanded by shell control operators or path escape. Explain expected guard behavior and required tests. Do not edit files.
